title: Yellowed Smoky Croatian Lamb Stew
description: A traditional Croatian dish featuring lamb leg, this stew is smoky, pillowy, and perfect for a sick day, with ayurvedic-rajasic-friendly ingredients and sashimi-cut lamb for a unique twist.
instructions: Heat oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Add the sashimi-cut lamb leg and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Add the smoked paprika, dried thyme, salt, and black pepper, and stir to combine.
Add the chopped carrots and potatoes, chicken broth, and tomato paste, and stir to combine.
Bring the stew to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 1.5 hours.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh parsley or thyme, if desired.
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
